entities.summary: Notre-Dame-de-l-Arche-d'Alliance is a modern cube-shaped Catholic church located at 81 rue d'Alleray in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. It was designed by the firm Architecture-Studio and was built between 1996 and 1999
